description: ADR-0023 decision 1. Which files a gate's or criterion's argv names that do the judging. A token counts when it names an existing regular file inside the project and either is argv[0] given as a path (a script) or looks like a test: a directory segment in 'dirs', or a basename matching one of 'basenames' (fnmatch, case-insensitive). Nothing under a directory segment in 'exclude_dirs' counts: those are build output and installed dependencies, which a build legitimately rewrites. Every other named file (src/app.py in a grep, app.db, dist/index.html) is what is being checked, not the check.
